system_prompt: The two columns show the original photo and one candidate edit, with matched detail crops. Is the candidate ready to deliver for the exact request, with the requested direction, scope and strength and no obvious damage or missing detail? Answer Yes if it is ready, or No if it is wrong, visibly damaged, too weak, or uncertain. Return only Yes or No.
method: Post-pair diagnostic, same four known original groups and exact candidates, English only. Test each candidate separately in the second column. The frozen model does not see the expected label. Use a constrained first-token Yes/No argmax and record unconstrained top tokens separately. No threshold or deployment.
